property_summary: For any call to fallback sending exactly 10 ether at a strictly-increasing timestamp, the reference contract only transfers its entire balance to the caller when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 iff block.number % 15 == 0 after the call); the mutant inverts the condition and will drain the contract for some inputs where block.number % 15 != 0, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the conditional so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0 (invert condition).
